walkthrough.aiSocialScientist.gettingSta: Meet the AgentSociety² dual-role environment, initialize and configure a project, and begin an inspectable, executable social-science research loop.
walkthrough.step.welcome.title: Welcome to AI Social Scientist
walkthrough.step.welcome.description: See how AI Social Scientists, Silicon Participants, and human researchers collaborate in one research loop.
walkthrough.step.firstLaunch.title: Enter the Workspace
walkthrough.step.firstLaunch.description: Wait for Coder to finish starting, trust the folder, and optionally switch the UI language.
walkthrough.step.meetLayout.title: Meet the Layout
walkthrough.step.meetLayout.description: Map the numbered regions: activity bar, sidebar, editor, AI Chat, and status bar.
walkthrough.step.initProject.title: Initialize a Research Project
walkthrough.step.initProject.description: After saving an API key, initialize the research layout from the sidebar (TOPIC.md and folders), or open an existing workspace.
walkthrough.step.configure.title: Configure LLM and Backend
walkthrough.step.configure.description: Open a project folder first, enter and save API Key / Base to .env, then start the local backend when ready.
walkthrough.step.exploreSkills.title: Extend Research with Skills
walkthrough.step.exploreSkills.descripti: See the PersonAgent architecture, distinguish Silicon Participant skills from AI Social Scientist research skills, and connect MCP tools.
walkthrough.step.startChat.title: Run a Research Loop
walkthrough.step.startChat.description: Use the AI Social Scientist to move from a question to reviewable hypotheses, experiments, analysis, and manuscript artifacts.
walkthrough.step.cliAssistants.title: Claude Code and Codex
walkthrough.step.cliAssistants.descripti: Choose official sign-in or a third-party Gateway, connect skills and MCP, and start Claude Code / Codex safely.
walkthrough.step.glossary.title: Glossary
walkthrough.step.glossary.description: Quick reference for AgentSociety², Agent, Skill, MCP, Bypass, and more.
